summary: Iteration-3 testing complete. Backend 28/28 pytest pass (19 new regulations+session + 9 regression). Frontend end-to-end flow verified: landing hook + removed over-claims, pre-exam detail/pact/token flow, 3-column exam screen on desktop with regulation viewer (PDF iframe fetches 200 application/pdf, Excel sheet+tabs), timer continues after viewer, worksheet formulas (A1*A2=5.000, SUM range, ROUND(10/3;2)=3,33, #DIV/0, #CIRC) with cross-dialog persistence, autosave + resume-after-refresh keeps answers+timer, submit flow with unanswered warning -> /selesai (with ONE bug: 'Soal Terjawab: undefined dari 40'), result page + retake, /exam/{id} redirects to /selesai after submit, admin Peraturan tab has all expected test-ids and 2 pre-seeded TEST_ docs. Mobile 390: pre-exam no overflow, exam drawers work and list regulations; exam-screen documentElement scrollWidth > clientWidth at 390 (minor horizontal overflow worth checking).

ui_bugs.issue: Row 'Soal Terjawab' renders 'undefined dari 40' because the component reads r.answered but backend result has no 'answered' field (only correct/wrong/unanswered). Fix either frontend (`${r.correct + r.wrong} dari ${r.total}`) or backend (add 'answered': correct+wrong to result).

issues: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > clientWidth (390 vs <390) — minor horizontal overflow outside drawers. Review the top mobile button bar / timer header padding.

action_items: Fix 'undefined dari 40' in ExamFinished.jsx (`${r.correct + r.wrong} dari ${r.total}` or add 'answered' field in /api/exam/submit result).
Investigate minor horizontal overflow of ExamScreen at 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: ExamFinished.jsx L23 uses r.answered which does not exist on the backend result payload — produces 'undefined dari 40'.
server.py submit_exam: result object exposes correct/wrong/unanswered but not 'answered'. Consider adding 'answered': correct+wrong for symmetry; several places assume it exists.

regulations.py upload_chunk accepts any content <= CHUNK_BYTES but does not enforce total size vs the init-declared size incrementally — final mismatch is caught in complete (400). OK, just note the double buffering memory cost (full file reassembled in Python before storage upload).
RegulationViewer uses dynamic import('xlsx') which pulls a large bundle at first open; acceptable but worth noting for perf.
ExamContext.syncSession captures session_id snapshot via sessionRef — correct guard against stale closures.

server.save_exam filters answers by valid keys and allowed options (A..D), good defense; however submit_exam does not re-filter answers against session.question_ids for the scoring (uses payload.answers directly keyed by qid, which is safe since qmap only contains session qids).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — one visible bug (ExamFinished 'undefined'), everything else works

The two pre-existing TEST_ regulations on subject 85f1a3ac-c52a-4464-8af0-3d3257022eff should remain. The 'undefined dari 40' bug on /selesai is reproducible on any submit; main agent to fix in ExamFinished.jsx or server.py.
rca of the issue: ExamFinished.jsx L23 references session.result.answered but backend's /api/exam/submit builds result = {total, correct, wrong, unanswered, score, passed, materi_stats, ...} without an 'answered' key. Thus `${r.answered} dari ${r.total}` evaluates to 'undefined dari 40'. Reproduction: finish any exam, go to /selesai, inspect the 'Soal Terjawab' row. Mitigation (frontend-only, 1 line): change `${r.answered} dari ${r.total}` to `${r.correct + r.wrong} dari ${r.total}` in /app/frontend/src/pages/ExamFinished.jsx.
